metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 8 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the commits of the last 12 months (286 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is maykinmedia.nl (7 authors), with 99% of the 282 commits whose organisation is known; 1% of the commits come from 1 of 9 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
